stories.title: Mynydd Isa Scout leader to lead school repair team in Malawi over Christmas
stories.summary: A Scout leader from Mynydd Isa will spend Christmas and New Year in Malawi leading a team repairing a primary school damaged by a tropical cyclone. Lily, a leader with Mynydd Isa Scouts, has been selected to join a group of 10 Scouts from across the UK and is the only one travelling from Wales.

stories.summary: Parents must be treated as “vital to the care team” and not as visitors when their child receives neonatal care, Wales’ Women’s Minister has said. stories.title: Ken Skates praises ‘resilience’ of Connah’s Quay veterans’ hub
stories.summary: A Connah’s Quay veterans’ project that was told in 2022 it would end is still running, with its own café and veteran-led cleaning and gardening services. stories.title: Police ask people in south Flintshire to report places where they feel unsafe
stories.summary: Police are asking people in Mold, Buckley, Hawarden and Broughton to tell them about streets and public places where they feel unsafe. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team said it wants to identify “areas of concern” over the coming weeks. Reports can be made anonymously through StreetSafe, a service on the force’s website.
